query:
SELECT id, name, version, subject, 
  SUBSTRING(bodyText, 1, 200) AS bodyText_preview,
  (CASE WHEN bodyText LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp%' OR bodyHtml LIKE '%tmatkd.com/camp%' THEN 'HAS_BAD_URL' ELSE 'ok' END) AS url_status
FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE sequenceName = 'summer_camp_nurture'
ORDER BY id;
